title: Residual-Preserving HPSS Chain

G1_three_components.standard: HPSS must produce H, P, and R components
G1_three_components.measured: HPSSComponents dataclass with harmonic, percussive, residual fields

G2_noop_reconstruction.measured: ~8e-8 (empirically measured on sine + transient test signals)

G3_energy_audit.standard: RMS, LUFS, spectral residual, reconstruction error fields present
G3_energy_audit.measured: HPSSAudit with 10 fields: rms_before_db, rms_after_db, rms_delta_db, lufs_before, lufs_after, lufs_delta, spectral_residual_ratio, residual_energy_ratio, reconstruction_error, residual_preserved

G4_regression.standard: Existing chain processing works without error

G5_reports.standard: Summary report and audit data archived

mrs_regression.standard: MRS regression: 20 baseline tracks difference < 2.0 points
mrs_regression.note: Requires baseline audio set (shared with ACU-002)

risk_notes: R分量在特定音源上可能产生可听噪声 → 'attenuate' 模式提供降级选项
保留R改变历史preset的音色平衡 → 'discard' 模式可用于A/B对比
LUFS测量依赖pyloudnorm（非默认依赖）→ best-effort静默降级
